data.description:
## Context / Problem

`make verify` is rebar's stated pre-push contract (`AGENTS.md`). It cannot run to green under the agent sandbox on macOS. Investigation under `peaceable-chunky-harvestmen` (`0eba-cfd8-34b0-4cb7`) established the true failure census against unmodified `origin/main`:

- **51 total failures** in `make test` under the sandbox
- **4** are POSIX named-semaphore (`SemLock`) denials — owned by `0eba`, root cause confirmed there
- **47 remain, uncharacterised** — this ticket

The 47 were previously lumped together with the SemLock failures under a single "~52 failures" heading. That conflation is what this ticket exists to undo. They are not one defect; the evidence shows at least three further distinct capability denials, each needing its own remedy.

Named so far, from the `0eba` investigation, as candidates rather than a complete census:

- `pypandoc` / pandoc subprocess execution
- `ps` denial
- git identity assumptions

That list is explicitly incomplete. No triage of the 47 has been performed.

## Why this matters

Fixing the 4 SemLock failures does **not** restore `make verify` as a local gate. `0eba` removes one blocker of several. Until the remaining 47 are characterised and addressed, every agent working this repository pushes changes validated only by `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and targeted tests, relying on Gerrit CI's `Verified` vote as the sole real gate.

`AGENTS.md` is explicit that this is not sufficient: a large family of this repo's invariants is enforced by pytest rather than by a lint script — the ratchets' baseline-vs-tree comparisons, the public-API surface census, CI-workflow parity, generated-artifact and docs drift, and whole-tree AST policy scans. On 2026-09-04 three separate changes were pushed red by exactly those tests after their authors saw `make lint` and `make typecheck` green (bug `1035-bed7-c855-4732`). That is the failure mode this gap reopens, for every sandboxed agent, continuously.

## Acceptance criteria

1. A complete census of the 47 non-SemLock failures exists, each attributed to a specific denied capability or environmental assumption — not a summary count, a per-failure attribution.
2. Failures are grouped into distinct root causes, with a count per cause. The number of distinct causes is stated as a finding.
3. For each root cause, a determination of whether it is remediable in the sandbox, and by what means.
4. Any remedy preserves full coverage in CI. No test may lose CI coverage to accommodate the sandbox.
5. **No silent skips.** Any coverage that genuinely cannot run in the sandbox produces a loud, counted signal. A test that vanishes without a visible count is not an acceptable outcome.
6. **No environment-name heuristics.** Detection is by direct capability probe — attempt the operation and observe the result. Username, hostname, and CI environment variables are not acceptable discriminators.
7. A stated verdict on whether `make verify` can be made green under the sandbox at all, once these and the `0eba` failures are addressed.

## Escalation clause

If the evidence shows that supporting both CI runs and local sandboxed runs is not achievable while following CI and DevOps best practice, do not invent a compromise. State what specifically makes it unachievable and lay out the options with their real tradeoffs. "This cannot be done cleanly" is an acceptable and valuable finding, and is preferable to a remedy that quietly degrades the gate.

## Notes

The 4 SemLock failures are out of scope — they belong to `0eba`. Reference for the confirmed mechanism there: the sandbox denies Darwin `sem_open` with `EPERM`, and CPython has no fallback because `sem_init` returns `ENOSYS`. Expect the 47 to involve different mechanisms; do not assume they share one.

Worker count is not a remedy for any part of this. The runner-level (pytest-xdist) failure population was measured at exactly **0** — xdist brings its worker pool up successfully under the sandbox and reached 99% of the suite.
data.title: 47 non-SemLock sandbox test failures are uncharacterised and still block `make verify` as a local gate
